newsitem.title: USA: Knight-Ridder Inc Q4 net income rises.
newsitem.headline: Knight-Ridder Inc Q4 net income rises.

text.p: (in thousands of dollars, except per share data)

NOTE: In the fourth quarter, Knight-Ridder earned $0.79 per share, up 146.9 percent from the $0.32 earned in the fourth quarter last year. This number includes the gain on the sale of the Netscape investment, net of adjustments in the carrying value of certain investments.
Earnings for the quarter excluding those items were $0.72 per share.
The numbers for both full years include one-time gains on sales. 1996's $2.75 EPS includes an $0.89 gain on the sale of Knight-Ridder Financial on July 26, 1996.
The 1995 $1.67 includes a $0.54 gain on the sale of the Journal of Commerce on April 3, 1995.

Excluding those gains, and the 1996 gain on the sale of the Netscape investment, net of adjustments in the carrying value of certain investments, the yearly earnings were $1.79 and $1.13, respectively -- for an increase of 58.4% in 1996 vs. 1995.
